items.title: Nex-N2.6: open-weight 321B MoE agentic model (built on GLM-5.3-Flash) with 83.0 OSWorld and 84.1 Terminal-Bench 2.1 in the lab's own table
items.summary: Shanghai Innovation Institute's Nex team released weights, code and API access for a multimodal agent model that reports reasoning repetition down from 16.0% to 1.6% and 100% valid tool selection over 956 contexts. A third-party breakdown notes that on the lab's own table Terminal-Bench is flat against the base and AutomationBench drops from 48.8 to 45.7.

doubt.pushback: All numbers are the lab's self-reported table; a third-party read shows mixed results versus the base model (flat Terminal-Bench, lower AutomationBench).

items.title: Lazarus: reprogramming fewer than 10 dormant neurons backdoors an LLM agent with no training, and a cosine-similarity weight scan against the base model flags it
items.summary: A Microsoft-collaborated paper and write-up shows dormant MLP neurons in SwiGLU models can be rewired into trigger detectors that force a shell command (for example on a date) while benchmarks stay unchanged. It reports detection by diffing against the original weights and recommends provenance checks and harnesses that do not blindly execute model output.

items.title: Proxima Fusion releases a dataset of 177k optimized stellarator coilsets with a live leaderboard on the Hugging Face Hub
items.summary: A dataset and open leaderboard where models generate stellarator coils in a single forward pass from a plasma shape and engineering constraints, giving ML researchers a benchmark in fusion design.

doubt.pushback: Primary dataset link not opened; announcement relayed by a Hugging Face staffer.
